name: onarrival
description: Search, compare and book flights and hotels on your OnArrival account. Your agent holds the fare and gives you a payment link you pay on OnArrival's secure payment page. It can also cancel a booking, set price alerts, and book corporate fares, with your company's GST details taken on the payment page.

interface.shortDescription: Book flights and hotels, pay by link
interface.longDescription: Search and compare flights and hotels, hold one on your OnArrival account, and get a payment link to pay on OnArrival's secure payment page yourself, or to send on. Cancel a booking, set a price alert on a flight, and book corporate fares, with your company's GST details taken on the payment page.
defaultPrompt: Find me a morning flight from Bengaluru to Delhi next Friday for one adult.
